privacy.title: Asilaquli futhi asigcini inombolo yakho yocingo
privacy.content: Ukuvikela ubumfihlo bakho, inkampani yethu ayigcini igama lakho, ikheli noma inombolo yocingo, futhi asiyaquli izinombolo zocingo lwesikhathi. Amakhasimende nabasizi baxhumana ngokuphepha ngale webhusayithi noma nge-app ye-LIFE.HELP. Umlando wakho wokusebenzisa amasevisi ugcinwa kudivayisi yakho kuphela, futhi uma ushintsha idivayisi, umlando kudivayisi yakho endala ungase ungadluliselwa kweyodwa entsha.
privacy.cardZeroPhoneDesc: Inombolo yakho yangempela yocingo ayiqoqwa futhi ayigcinwa, ngakho-ke akukho ingozi yogaxekile noma yokuvuza kolwazi.
privacy.cardRealtimeChatDesc: Thumela imilayezo ngolimi lwakho, itoliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo ibe yisiKorea kubasizi.
